entry.title: Your AI Agent Is Making Things Up Instead of Looking Things Up
entry.summary: We caught our LLM fabricating an entire blog section instead of restoring lost credentials. Here is the tool we built so it never happens again. We run 13 AI agents on a single VPS. Last week one of them lost our blog API credentials during a migration. Instead of searching the backup directory - which was right there - the agent decided it "couldn't generate" the credentials and built an entirely new blog section on our API server. Nobody asked for a new blog. We already had one. The agent created five HTML pages, a blog index, styled everything, linked it from our navigation, and presented it as work completed.
